Eating tacos
Dec 2025 • Business
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Tacos Fuego is hands down one of the best Mexican restaurants I’ve tried in Ho Chi Minh City. From the moment you arrive, the place has a lively, welcoming vibe that feels authentic and relaxed. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always happy to explain the menu or recommend dishes, which makes the experience even better.
The food is absolutely delicious. The tacos are packed with flavor, made with fresh ingredients, and perfectly balanced. The tortillas are soft, the meat is juicy and well-seasoned, and the salsas add just the right amount of kick without overpowering the dish. I also really enjoyed the sides – everything tasted homemade and thoughtfully prepared. Portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality you get.
What I appreciate most is the consistency. Every visit has been great, whether dining in or ordering online. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and ideal for hanging out with friends or having a casual dinner.
If you’re craving authentic Mexican food in Saigon, Tacos Fuego is a must-try. I’ll definitely keep coming back and recommending it to everyone I know! 🌮🔥

Taste
May 2021 • Couples
Went here based on the reviews here on TA. Must admit there were not many reviews so they may have been skewed to a more positive trend then mine. The place is small and nicely decorated. The staff was prompt in attending to us, and very attentive throughout our stay. However, we both were disappointed in the taste of the food. For Mexican cuisine it was pretty tasteless unless you added the hot sauce. It seemed even then that the hot sauce was a Vietnamese rendition of hot sauce. The meats all seemed to have no seasoning. The tortilla shell's were quite bland. Worst of all was the chicken enchilada sauce. It hD some sort of curdled dairy product as its sauce. Neither of us could eat it. The prices are quite reasonable I must say. Nothing comes as a complete meal e.g. enchilada, rice and beans. If you want that it is available ala carte. But that pushes the price way beyond the normal prices one would expect. Certainly not the best Mexican in HCMC, but not the worst either. Other reviews state the owner imported the California Mexican taste. Having lived in California I never recall Mexican done this way.
